description: Run 003: a universal header with original storm-and-totems art, an original totem icon set, social cards with the art, item facts (equip, note, short source), the items page with stat columns, Tidecaller's own WoW-style item popups on every item link, View on Wowhead links from spec section 14.5, visible labels on the Water Shield and talent boxes, and Wowhead item icons beside item names (US-009, added after the first five stories; the icon files are already in public/icons/, never download or change them). FULL PRD: tasks/ralph-runs/003-header-icon-item-popups/prd.md (read its Design inputs and Research findings; the design files are in tasks/ralph-runs/003-header-icon-item-popups/design/). The run 001 PRD (tasks/ralph-runs/001-tidecaller-v1/prd.md) still describes the architecture; spec section 14 holds the owner's rulings. Item level and armor value are NOT in the spec: do not add them.

userStories.title: The totem icon in the tab, on phones and in the manifest
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want Tidecaller to have its own icon, so I can spot it among my tabs and on my home screen.
acceptanceCriteria: `public/favicon.svg` is `design/totem.svg` (byte for byte, or minified without changing a shape)

`scripts/og.mjs` renders the PNG icons from `public/favicon.svg` instead of the old wave mark: `public/apple-touch-icon.png` 180 x 180 (the badge at about 84% on a full-bleed `#03060d` square: iOS does not keep transparency), `public/icon-192.png` and `public/icon-512.png` (the badge on transparent), and a new `public/icon-maskable-512.png` (the badge at 72% on full-bleed `#0a2a36`, inside the maskable safe zone)
A new `public/favicon.ico` holding 16, 32 and 48 px PNG images of the badge, written by `scripts/og.mjs` (a small ICO writer in the script; no new dependency)
`site.webmanifest`: the three icons, the maskable one with `"purpose": "maskable"`, `theme_color` `#03060d`
`src/seo/head.ts`: `<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="48x48">` before the SVG icon link; both `theme-color` metas become `#03060d`

Tests (Vitest): each PNG's width and height read from its IHDR chunk match the sizes above; the ICO header says 3 images of 16, 32 and 48; the manifest parses and lists the icons; every prerendered page's head has the ico, svg, apple-touch and manifest links
Run `node scripts/og.mjs` and commit what it writes. The social cards are redone in US-003; leave them as they render now
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome npm run smoke` pass

userStories.title: A universal header with the storm-and-totems art
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want a header that looks like a WoW site, with the Tidecaller name styled and a line about what the site is, on every page.
acceptanceCriteria: Look at `design/mock-desktop.png`, `design/mock-phone.png` and `design/header-mock.html` first; match them

`design/header-scene.mjs` becomes `scripts/header-art.mjs` (comment at the top: run by hand, writes `public/art/header-tide.svg`, commit the result); running it reproduces `design/header-tide.svg` byte for byte at `public/art/header-tide.svg`

`SiteHeader.tsx`: the wordmark link holds ``, the word **Tidecaller** and a small kicker **Restoration Shaman**, its accessible name being that visible text; the nav is unchanged (same links, same `aria-current`); under the nav row, a tagline block: a display-font line **"Resto Shaman stat weights and best in slot"** and a smaller line built from `src/site.ts` (add `SITE_TAGLINE` there): **"WoW Forever beta 1.60.1, level 30. Every number is in points of Healing."**. No heading elements in the header (each page keeps exactly one `h1`)

CSS (port from the mock into `src/styles/app.css`, replacing the old `header.site` rules): the art as the header's background, `right bottom`, `background-size: max(100%, 2400px) auto` with `#03060d` behind it and `min-height: 270px` on desktop; at `max-width: 640px` the art is `auto 210px`, the tagline's second line hides and the nav fits one row at 400 px; a left-to-right dark overlay keeps the text readable; the wordmark in the display font with the pale-cyan gradient fill and soft glow; nav links light on dark, the current page underlined in cyan; a wave-shaped bottom edge filled with `var(--bg)` so the page flows out of the header in both themes; in print the header loses the art and prints as plain text
The header looks the same in the light and dark themes (only the wave edge follows `--bg`); focus outlines on the header links stay visible on the dark art

Smoke (beside the existing header checks): on `/`, `/bis` and an item page the header's computed `background-image` contains `header-tide.svg` and `GET /art/header-tide.svg` answers 200 with `image/svg+xml`; the tagline text is in the header; the wordmark image loads (`naturalWidth > 0`); at 400 px wide there is no sideways scroll and every nav link is inside the viewport; the page still has exactly one `h1`
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npm run smoke` pass

userStories.title: Item facts: equip text, notes and where it comes from
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one place that splits an item's extra text into equip effect and note, and shortens its source to a place, so the table and the popup say the same thing.
acceptanceCriteria: New `src/lib/itemFacts.ts` exporting `equipText(item)`, `noteText(item)` and `whereShort(item)`, following the PRD's research findings (the rule for equip and note; the "where" labels)

Tests: every row of the PRD's "where" table, by item; for every one of the 155 items `whereShort` is one of: a kind alone (`World drop`, `Quest`, `Shaman quest`, `Vendor`, `Reputation`, `Unknown`), `Crafted, <profession>`, `<kind>, <place>`, or `<place>`, and every `<place>` appears verbatim in that item's `source` (the guard that nothing is invented)

Tests: every item with `other` gets exactly one of equip or note; Tidebringer's Claw's equip is "+2% crit on Healing Wave and Lesser Healing Wave"; Satchel of Potions's equip is "Use: random potion"; Painwalker Buckler's equip is "Proc when struck: 12 mp5 for 10 sec"; Ghostly Mantle's note is "Nerfed Oct 8"; Runemender's Seal's note is "Unique"
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass

userStories.title: The items page shows every stat in columns
userStories.description: As a player, I want the items page to show each item's level, stats, equip effect and where it drops beside its score, so I can compare gear at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: `/items` keeps one table per slot, in slot order, and each table's columns are: **Item**, **Lvl**, **Int**, **Spr**, **SP**, **Heal**, **MP5**, **Equip**, **Where**, **Score**. Headers use `abbr` titles (Required level, Intellect, Spirit, Spell Power, Healing, Mana per 5 seconds, Dungeon boss score in points of Healing)
Item: the name links to the item page; a small Horde or Alliance tag follows the name when the item is not for both factions (the Faction column goes)

Lvl is `req`, blank when 0; the five stats are the spec's numbers, blank when 0; Equip is `equipText`; Where is `whereShort`, with the full `source` as the cell's `title`; Score is the Dungeon boss score as now (one decimal)

Numbers right-aligned in the mono font; Equip and Where in smaller text that wraps; on narrow screens the table scrolls sideways inside its box with the Item column sticky, and the page itself never scrolls sideways at 400 px
The lead paragraph says what the columns are, that blank means none, and that scores are for a Dungeon boss fight at the calculator defaults

Smoke (beside the existing `/items` checks): the Head table's header row reads the ten columns in order; Holy Shroud's row reads Lvl 27, Heal 33, Spr 6, Where "World drop", Score 38.9; Tidebringer's Claw's Equip shows "+2% crit on Healing Wave and Lesser Healing Wave"; at 400 px there is no page-level sideways scroll
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npm run smoke` pass

userStories.title: Item popups on every item link
userStories.description: As a player, I want to hover or tab to any item name on the site and see its stats in a popup, like Wowhead's, without leaving the page.
acceptanceCriteria: A small script, its own Vite entry (for example `src/tips/tips.ts`), built, hashed and loaded with `<script type="module">` on **every** page including `/`; the prerender writes the tag with the hashed path. No framework, no third-party request; the item data it needs is bundled in. Under 12 KB gzipped (a test or build check reads the built file's gzip size)

It works by event delegation on `document` for `a[href^="/items/"]`, so links React renders later on `/` get popups too. On devices with hover: show after about 80 ms of hovering, place it beside the pointer, keep it inside the viewport (flip left or up near an edge), hide on leave. On keyboard focus: show beside the link, hide on blur or Escape. On touch: no popup (a tap opens the item page as now)

The popup (`role="tooltip"`, the link gets `aria-describedby` while it shows) reads like a WoW tooltip, from spec section 12 and `itemFacts` only: the name; the slot, with the armor type on the right when not "-"; the stats that are not 0 (`+6 Spirit`, `+33 Healing`, `+12 Spell Power`, `+3 MP5`, `+11 Intellect`, `+4 Stamina`), Healing, Spell Power and MP5 in green; the equip text in green; "Requires level N" when `req` > 0; the note in muted text; "Source: ..." with the full source; "Horde only" or "Alliance only"; "Only a Tailoring crafter can wear it" style text for `prof` (Engineering: "Needs Engineering to use"). No score in the popup (the calculator's scores follow the visitor's own settings)

Styled dark navy with a thin blue-grey border and soft shadow in both themes, the name in the display font, max width about 320 px, never covering the pointer; no animation when `prefers-reduced-motion` is set

SEO test: `script[type="module"]` count is the app script only where `hydrate` is true plus exactly one popup script on every page; update the root `CLAUDE.md` SEO rule sentence "Only the calculator page hydrates; content pages ship no app JavaScript." to add that every page also loads the small item popup script, and nothing else in that file

Smoke (beside the item link checks of each page): on `/items` hovering "Holy Shroud" shows a popup containing "+33 Healing", "+6 Spirit", "Requires level 27" and "World drop / auction house" and hides on mouse out; focusing the link with the keyboard shows it and Escape hides it; on `/` hovering an item name in the best set shows a popup; at 400 px a popup near the right edge stays inside the viewport
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npm run smoke` pass; `npm run reference` still 26 of 26 (the calculator page now loads a second script)

userStories.title: View on Wowhead from each item page
userStories.description: As a player, I want a link from an item's page to the same item on Wowhead, so I can see its model, icon and comments there.
acceptanceCriteria: Read `docs/spec.md` section 14.5 first. `scripts/extract-spec-data.mjs` also extracts its JSON block (heading "### 14.5 Wowhead item IDs and icons (links and art only)") to `src/data/wowhead.json`, an object of item name to `{ "id", "icon" }`; the existing test that the data files equal the spec covers it

Tests: every key in `wowhead.json` is an item name in `items.json`; every `id` is a positive integer; no two items share an ID; Holy Shroud is `{ id: 2721, icon: "inv_helmet_16" }`, Tidebringer's Claw's id is 280605, Battle Healer's Cloak's is 19529; Red Wool Cloak has no entry; there are 141 entries

Item page, in "Where it comes from": when the item has an entry, a link **"View <item name> on Wowhead"** to `https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=<id>` (opens in a new tab, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`), followed by one sentence: Wowhead's numbers can differ from Tidecaller's, which come from the Forever beta client, build 1.60.1. No link when there is no entry. The internal-link checks still pass (external `https://` links are allowed)
About page sources list: Wowhead's Forever database, used only for the "View on Wowhead" links and the item icons; its stats are not used
Smoke: `/items/holy-shroud` links to `https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=2721`; `/items/red-wool-cloak` has no Wowhead link
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npm run smoke` pass

userStories.title: Say what the boxes beside Water Shield and the talent are
userStories.description: As a player, I want the number boxes beside Water Shield and the Spirit regen talent to say what they are, so I know Water Shield's 5 is my crit chance.
acceptanceCriteria: The box beside Water Shield shows a visible label **"Crit %"** (small, above or beside the box) and the box beside the Spirit regen talent shows **"Kept %"**; their accessible names stay "Heal crit chance, percent" and "Share kept while casting, percent"
Water Shield's description reads: "Each heal crit returns 2% of max mana. Enter your heal crit chance; 5% is the default."
Layout holds at 400 px and in both themes; disabled states still grey the label with the box
Smoke (beside the regen panel checks): the visible text "Crit %" sits within 60 px of `#crit`; "Kept %" within 60 px of `#pct`
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run smoke` and `npm run reference` (26 of 26) pass

userStories.title: Item icons beside item names
userStories.description: As a player, I want each item's in-game icon beside its name in the tables and popups, so I can recognise gear at a glance the way I do in game.
acceptanceCriteria: Read the "Item icons" research finding first. Use the files already in `public/icons/`; do not download, add, rename or delete any

A helper (for example `itemIconSrc(item)` beside the Wowhead data) returns `/icons/<icon>.jpg` from `wowhead.json`, or `/icons/inv_misc_questionmark.jpg` when the item has no entry. Test: for all 155 items the file it names exists in `public/icons/`

One small component renders the icon: `` with `width` and `height` set (20 px in tables), `alt=""` (the name beside it is the label), `loading="lazy"`, `decoding="async"`, a 1 px dark border and slightly rounded corners, vertically centred with the text, a small gap before the name, never wrapping apart from the name

The icon shows before the item name in: the calculator's best set table and its candidate (other items) table on `/`; every table on `/items`; the `/bis` table; the slot pages' tables; and at 40 px in the popup (left of the name, the way WoW tooltips show it). The item page shows a 56 px icon beside its `h1` (the `h1` text is unchanged). An item the visitor added themself on `/` (a custom item) shows no icon
Layout holds at 400 px (no page-level sideways scroll; the sticky Item column on `/items` keeps icon and name together) and in both themes

Smoke (beside each page's existing checks): on `/items` the Holy Shroud row's icon has `src` ending `/icons/inv_helmet_16.jpg` and loads (`naturalWidth` 56 after scrolling it into view); Red Wool Cloak's row shows the question-mark icon; on `/` the best set's Head row shows an icon that loads; `/items/holy-shroud` shows the 56 px icon beside the `h1`; the Holy Shroud popup shows its icon
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run smoke` and `npm run reference` (26 of 26) pass
